answer.evidence: The main body spans rows 14-31. Rows 14-19 form a top band with a light highlight at row 14 and indicator lights. The thin antennas at rows 9-13 are small details and do not count toward the body. The band could be read as a vertical panel face, but the overhanging edge line and the shadow row below it support a top surface of about 6 rows over a front face of about 10 rows.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a grey control console with small red indicator lights on top. Its dark edge pixels are 100% near-neutral, so the outline is a neutral near-black line around the whole shape, the sticker look the standard rejects. Its 12 distinct colours are far below the richer references (stall 40, well 38), roughly on par with the hedge and lamp (11 and 14). The 11 colours per tile are comparable to the hedge (10) and below the stall (17) and well (20). Flat-fill coverage is low at 4%, with only a few knob and button dots as texture. The main body ramp has only about 3 lightness steps (light panel top, mid grey, dark base), against about 5-6 for the references' material ramps. Structure is clean but shallow: the outline is neutral black rather than a tinted dark material tone, and the shading is thinner than the references. The lamp reference also has a neutral outline, but it is a thin object that gets leniency, whereas this console is a solid block where the near-black outline is more noticeable.
